mo_ta_cong_viec:
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop professional, sustainable, and secure applications using cutting-edge technologies to enhance efficiency and quality.
Participate in both Back-end (.NET, MS SQL) and Front-end (Angular, Blazor) development.
Ensure compliance with functional and non-functional requirements, including security, performance, scalability, and usability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions.
Provide technical insights and propose cost-effective solutions to business requirements.
Mentor junior developers and share best practices for coding standards and architecture.
yeu_cau:
REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
At least 4 - 9 years of hands-on experience in software development.
Strong proficiency in MS SQL and relational database design.
Expertise in Microsoft technologies: ASP.NET Core, .NET 5/6, MVC Framework, REST API development, background services.
Front-end development experience with Angular, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML 5, CSS 3 and Blazor.
Familiarity with Azure Cloud services like App Service, Azure Storage, Key Vault, Azure Function, Logic-App, etc.
Hands-on experience with version control systems and ability to implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps for automated builds and deployments.
Skilled in debugging and monitoring tools (Postman, Fiddler, Application Insights) for troubleshooting and performance optimization.
Understanding of enterprise standards: logging, monitoring, access control, and secure data handling.
Knowledge of OOP Concept & software architecture principles, including microservices and SOA.
Experience with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) for building low-code/no-code solutions and integrating with enterprise systems.
Comfortable working in Agile and traditional waterfall models.
Strong English communication skills with ability to work effectively with regional teams.
Cross-cultural sensitivity and fully understand and adopt company's values
Experience in sizeable multinational corporations to work with large cross-functional teams.

Your Career
There is one overriding reason for our success – and that is you. If you are not growing, then neither are we.
Your Leave
Enjoy your time off, you’ve earned it! Work life balance is essential, we offer generous holiday allowances, as well as loyalty leave and charity leave.
Your Lifestyle
Work. Life. Balance. We want to support good health and wellbeing and know that your lifestyle is key to this.  The way we work and how we relax are recognised through our lifestyle benefits.
Your Community
Giving something back. Community is at the heart of how we operate and our ethos. To recognise this we offer charity matching, charity leave and the opportunity to get involved in corporate fundraising events and activities.
